# 2 Baruch Chapter 62 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**1** "The black waters you saw after those bright ones represent all the evils done by all the kings who came after that good king — the kings who abandoned the law of the Lord."

**2** "They built high places, set up idols throughout the land, led all the people into every kind of sin, multiplied wrongdoing, and piled up transgressions."

**3** "They drew the sacrifices away from the Lord's temple, burned incense elsewhere, and stopped keeping the sacred months and festivals."

**4** "They killed the prophets; the voice of the righteous was silenced; and they forsook the law of the Lord."

**5** "The holy priests were driven out, and the pure and holy ones were removed from their positions."

**6** "Every king who came after these did likewise — their deeds were just the same."

**7** "There was no one who kept the law in their hearts, no one who feared the Lord; only a few among them were righteous."

**8** "These are the fourth black waters you saw."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Prioritizes clarity and natural English flow while preserving the theological and narrative content of the Syriac source.*
